case_synthetic_ios27.description: SYNTHETIC fixture, not a real device. A fabricated logs/ManagedSettings tree (com.example.* identifiers, SYNTH-CAT-* categories, generated UUIDs, fabricated key material) with the iOS 27.0 store names (ContentAndPrivacy, Restrictions, defaultGroup, downtime, scheduleDowntime, bedtime, UserSafety, Default), a store with no setting key, a store with an unknown key, an unreadable store file, tokenized copies, an AppleDouble sidecar and a decoy folder, built by admin/test/scripts/synthetic_managed_settings.py, packed in a sysdiagnose-shaped archive and cut with make_test_data.py. It carries no data from any real extraction.
